title: Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions
summary: From a smooth semipositive anticanonical metric on a smooth projective complex variety, we construct an unweighted integrable semipositive metric on a corrected anticanonical line of a smooth base, using a normal equidimensional toroidal model and full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero. The explicit rational boundary correction pulls back to an exceptional divisor. On varieties without positive-degree holomorphic forms, two-metric transfer gives sections with prescribed boundary poles from a finite-volume log-anticanonical metric and a target line with bounded semipositive weights.…

review.reason: Constructs semipositive metrics on corrected anticanonical lines using toroidal models.
